summary: Solid production-quality infrastructure code. Workflow follows GitHub Actions best practices (pinned actions, least-privilege, proper triggers, shell: pwsh). PowerShell code uses Set-StrictMode and $ErrorActionPreference correctly; parameter validation present. Minor issues: (1) Module import in Generate-Matrix.ps1 lacks success validation before calling functions; (2) Complex algorithms in MatrixGenerator.psm1 (Get-MatrixCombinations, Add-IncludedCombinations) need more inline comments explaining logic; (3) Run-ActTests.ps1 hardcodes expectedPesterPassed=35 (fragile if tests change). Workflow redundantly defines MATRIX_CONFIG_PATH as env var when script already defaults it. Error handling is comprehensive and user-facing messages are helpful.
